query: What signals suggest a support ticket will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: priority_rank
per_column.rationale: This is a deterministic re-encoding of the existing 'priority' column already present in the original table; it adds no new signal beyond what priority already carries.

per_column.name: description_word_count
per_column.rationale: Derived from issue_description, known at ticket creation, and plausibly correlated with resolution time (longer descriptions may indicate more complex issues). A weak but legitimate ex-ante predictor.

per_column.name: urgency_keyword_count
per_column.rationale: Counts urgency-signaling words in the description, available before resolution and plausibly related to how the ticket is handled and how long it takes. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: multi_system_keyword_count
per_column.rationale: Signals that multiple systems are involved, a plausible driver of longer resolution. Known at intake from the description, no leakage.

per_column.name: investigation_keyword_count
per_column.rationale: Mentions of investigation/diagnosis in the description plausibly indicate harder, longer tickets. Ex-ante and not a restatement of the focus.

per_column.name: scope_keyword_count
per_column.rationale: Captures breadth/scope language that plausibly correlates with resolution effort. Available at intake, legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: has_error_code
per_column.rationale: Presence of an error code in the description is a diagnosable-at-intake signal that could shorten or lengthen resolution; a valid, outside-the-focus predictor.

per_column.name: channel_complexity
per_column.rationale: This is a deterministic re-encoding of the existing 'channel' column (three channels mapped to complexity levels); it duplicates information already in the original table rather than adding new signal.

per_column.name: composite_complexity_score
per_column.rationale: An aggregate of the keyword/complexity features. It is built from ex-ante inputs and not from the focus, so it is a legitimate (if partly redundant with its components) predictor of resolution time.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are legitimate ex-ante features derived from issue_description that plausibly carry signal about how long a ticket takes to resolve, with no post-outcome leakage. Two columns (priority_rank, channel_complexity) merely re-encode existing original columns and add no new leverage, and the composite score is largely a combination of the other keyword features (redundant but valid). The keyword-count features are somewhat mechanical and sparse (many zeros), limiting individual strength, but as a set they provide moderate genuine predictive lift beyond priority and channel.
